head: iPhone 18 delayed again? Mass production may slip to January
dek: The leaker Fixed Focus Digital says on Weibo that neither the iPhone 18 nor the iPhone 18e has started mass production, and that the start has moved to around New Year's Day 2027. Apple hasn't commented.
details: In October the same leaker had pointed to late November for the standard iPhone 18. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman expects both phones to be introduced in February or March 2027. MacRumors says a January start would leave Apple less time than usual to build up stock. Both phones are rumored to use the A20 chip.
where: Rumor; iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e expected in February or March 2027
means: If you're waiting for the regular iPhone 18 or the 18e, this leak doesn't change the expected spring window, but it leaves less room for stock at launch.
todo: Nothing to do yet; Apple hasn't announced either phone or a date.
